title: Beyond chemical catalysis: laser production of clean energy
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9500-9529
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00087D, Review Article
Bo Yan, Weiwei Cao, Guowei Yang
Laser bubbling in liquids (LBL) employs laser-induced micro/nanobubbles to provide extreme reaction environments under normal conditions, enabling efficient clean energy conversion and green synthesis with notable thermodynamic/kinetic advantages.
